Matey Tallhamper is a wood elf sailor at the Grey Harbour Docks in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in Act Three.
“
'Look for striped sails' they said. Every other ship's got stripes on its sails. Like asking us to look for a fish with a tail.
„
— Matey Tallhamper

Involvement

Act Three

Matey Tallhamper and fellow sailor  Dollivar Noot are talking to each other at the docks. They are on the lookout for a ship they were supposed to leave on, unaware it has already left.

If  Gortash is defeated, Matey Tallhamper and Dollivar Noot leave and can no longer be found.

Idle banter

  • Matey Tallhamper
    I'm starting to think they've forgotten about us.
  • Dollivar Noot
    They'd better not. They haven't even paid us for the shipment yet.
  • Matey Tallhamper
    I ain't seen no new ships in a while though.
  • Dollivar Noot
    They can't have sailed off without us, right?
  • Matey Tallhamper
    Better hope not, I'll run out of coin if I stay here a day longer than I have to.
  • Dollivar Noot
    I'd kill for a pint of mermaid's breath. These city brews ain't got much bite to 'em.
  • Dollivar Noot
    Is that The Endless Miracle?
  • Matey Tallhamper
    No, you conk. It ain't got stripes on the sails.
  • Dollivar Noot
    Aren't those stripes? I see stripes!
  • Matey Tallhamper
    Those are spots you idiot.
